inline.scopeMeaning: Pre-Binaryen DWARF4 candidates, not a post-optimization dynamic call stack

rawTickGaps.scope: Whole-process adjacent raw tick timestamp gaps; not work durations or source ownership.

workload.scope: Whole-process ticks remain conserved. Native timer markers and a conservative boundary allowance separate certain-interior, boundary and outside views; verified function containers preserve source-map gaps, while source ownership remains a candidate, with no exclusive subsystem duration claim.

lookupDistances.meaning: Gaps from sampled native PC to its preceding native source position and from the resulting WASM position to its preceding mapped segment. Exact positions do not prove source ownership; byte distances are not time, confidence or sampling-error bounds.

limits: Disjoint raw tick leaf-PC observations only; inclusive stack frames are not counted.
Whole-process ticks include construction, warmup and unrelated work; no emulator work-window duration is inferred.
Predecessor native source positions and source-map segments are attribution candidates, not proven exclusive ownership or elapsed durations.
Function-entry positions, unmapped spans, address-generation ties and ambiguous generations remain unresolved.
Numeric native function containers identify verified instruction ranges only; source-unresolved container ticks are not exclusive subsystem durations.
Inline labels identify verified pre-Binaryen scope candidates; later optimization, source-position predecessors and sparse sampling prevent exclusive-duration or dynamic-stack claims.

limits: Outer windows are half-open marker intervals and include marker/wrapper boundary overhead.

Interior classification assumes a stable host-clock rate shared by performance.now durations and V8 timer/tick timestamps, with a selected 2us rounding allowance; this is not a host latency guarantee.
Certain-interior ticks are strictly beyond both conservative boundary allowances; empty interiors supply no attribution.
Delimited source counts remain sampling candidates, not exclusive elapsed durations or causal ownership; no virtual device timing tolerance is inferred.
